chunks: It is He who sent His Apostle with the guidance and the true way to raise it above all faiths, however the idolaters may dislike it.
ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of sending the Prophet with guidance according to Surah As-Saff?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of 'Tajalli al-Din' (the manifestation of God's religion), emphasizing that the ultimate victory of Islam is not merely political but spiritual and comprehensive. It underscores the inevitability of the Prophet's message prevailing over all other creeds, a theme frequently associated with the era of Imam Mahdi (AJ) when divine truth will be fully established. The phrase 'even if the polytheists dislike it' highlights the contrast between the steadfastness of the faithful and the resistance of those attached to falsehood.
